gloss: as much as possible; to the extent possible

definitions.gloss: as much as possible; to the greatest extent possible
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression meaning to do something to the fullest extent one can. More formal than できるだけ.

examples.japanese: {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will reply as soon as possible.

examples.japanese: {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}して→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: I want as many people as possible to participate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should minimize the environmental impact as much as possible.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adverbial phrase used in both written and spoken Japanese. More polished than ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧, which has the same meaning but is more casual. Often used in business, official communications, and polite requests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (as soon as possible)
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り{多|おお}く (as much as possible)
- {可能|かのう}な{限|かぎ}り⟦{努力|どりょく}する→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧ (to make every possible effort)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧: as much as possible — more casual and commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦なるべく→なるべく：01281_narubeku⟧: as much as possible, preferably — similar level of casualness to ⟦できるだけ→できるだけ：01289_dekirudake⟧
